replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Soo hay Scaglia,

I watched the video, looked at the chat and tried to understand what was going on.
From what I saw, I think we can't do anything. He didn't threatened you and there are no indicators that he was the one who ddosed you. It also could be that your internet went offline because your router restarted or something like that. 
Sadly I have to deny this report because of lack of evidence. 
I know it's hard to get actual evidence of someone ddosing you, but without it we can't do anything for you and against him.
I hope you understand that.

Regards Flo/resepignev :)
